scope: Providers IA + Quality modules + Generators + 6 sub-prompts skill

findings.title: Providers lineup v2.0 confirmed
findings.description: 4 prod providers specified: OpenAI (text + image via gpt-4o), Anthropic (fallback text), Perplexity (data enrichment), Unsplash (stock imagery). gpt-image-1 deprecated v2.0 per spec.

findings.title: IProvider.ts interface mentioned but content not audited

findings.title: Fallback chain documented
findings.description: Spec clearly states: OpenAI text → Claude fallback. Anthropic long-form → OpenAI. Perplexity → skip if fail. Unsplash → IllustrationPlaceholder.
findings.expected: Fallbacks prevent cascading failures

findings.title: Circuit breaker Redis shared state spec'd
findings.description: § 9.11.6 defines: 5 consecutive errors in 30s → open 60s; half-open after 60s; state shared Redis so all workers see same circuit.
findings.status_actual: PASS - redis circuit breaker pattern specified
findings.expected: Circuit breaker prevents cascading provider failures

findings.title: Cost tracking per call in CostLedger model
findings.description: Prisma schema section 5.1 defines CostLedger table with jobId, provider, model, tokensInput, tokensOutput, costUsd, timestamp. Supports per-job cost tracking.
findings.expected: Every provider call logged with cost

findings.title: Kill switch global + monthly cost caps
findings.description: Spec mandates CONTENT_GEN_ENABLED=false env var (Setting DB) kills all jobs < 5s. Cost caps per provider: OpenAI /mo default, Anthropic /mo, Perplexity /mo, configurable admin.
findings.status_actual: PASS - kill switch + cost caps specified
findings.expected: Runaway spend prevented via hard caps

findings.title: Dedup-guard 4 couches v1.7 fully specified
findings.description: Couche A (pré-gen): Levenshtein title similarity 0.85 vs 1K recent, primary keyword + city + 90d check, embedding cosine 0.92 vs 500 articles. Couche B (post-gen): shingling 5-gram Jaccard. Couche C (future): Copyscape. Time decay 12mo implicit in 'recent 1K'.
findings.expected: dedup-guard.ts implements 4 layers with Levenshtein + embedding + Jaccard

findings.title: Plagiarism shingling 5-gram Jaccard specified
findings.description: plagiarism.ts uses 5-gram shingling with Jaccard similarity. Thresholds: internal Axion ≥0.30 → rewrite, RSS-derived vs source ≥0.10 → strict rewrite. Top 5 matching phrases logged.
findings.expected: plagiarism.ts prevents 30% internal + 10% RSS duplication

findings.title: Doctrine-check v2.1 validates 6 anti-AI signals
findings.description: doctrine-check.ts verifies: 1 opinion strong + 1 dated prediction + 1 internal figure + 1 1st-person plural paragraph + sentence length variance ≥8 words + no 3/5 lists. Also checks: no SIREN/SIRET/RCS, no banned phrases, Axion-IA naming strict. Warnings only, not blocking.
findings.expected: doctrine-check.ts validates all 6 signals + banned word list editable admin

findings.title: SEO-score deterministic grading 0-100
findings.description: seo-score.ts implements 13 criteria (word count 15pts, FAQ 10pts, direct answer 8pts, H1+H2 8pts, keyword placement 8pts, density 6pts, internal links 6pts, external 4pts, image alt 6pts, JSON-LD 8pts, readability 6pts, plagiarism 8pts, doctrine 7pts). Strict banding: 0-39=tier3, 40-69=tier2, 70-74=tier2+review, 75+=review.
findings.status_actual: PASS - scoring grid fully specified with tier gates
findings.expected: seo-score.ts calculates deterministic 0-100 + tier mapping

findings.title: Readability Flesch-Kincaid FR implemented
findings.description: readability.ts computes Flesch-Kincaid FR score (target ≥50). Specified in quality grid (6pts if ≥50).
findings.expected: readability.ts returns Flesch FR 0-100

findings.title: search-intent-validator.ts v1.7 not fully audited
findings.description: Master spec § 26 defines 5 search intents (informational, commercial_investigation, transactional, local, navigational) + alignment checks (slug pattern, meta title trigger, body structure, CTA, JSON-LD). Spec says search-intent-validator.ts exists but implementation details unreviewed.
findings.status_actual: UNKNOWN - validator file content not provided
findings.expected: search-intent-validator.ts validates intent alignment (slug + meta + structure + CTA + JSON-LD)

findings.title: Quality Loop v1.7 (§ 27) not yet implemented
findings.description: Spec mandates: if score 40-74 → auto repass ciblé (max 2×). Pipeline: analyze breakdown, identify weak sections, 2nd LLM call on weak sections only, recompute. Worker content-quality-improver separate queue (concurrency 3), cost cap /mo. NOT IMPLEMENTED - only specified.
findings.expected: Worker + queue + cost cap + section re-prompt logic implemented

findings.title: v2.1 accessible language doctrine added
findings.description: New requirement: audiences non-tech (TPE/PME/schools/etc) require glossary. Max 3 technical terms/1000 words without definition, or qualityScore -10pts. Validation in posts:validate extended.

findings.title: landing-audit, landing-interventions, landing-implementation not yet in sub-prompts
